messages:
evelyn: Okay who organized the beanie hat runway during the Q&A? i am weak. :beanie: :sunglasses:
chao: That was me. i call it "Beanie Bonanza". also shoutout to the llama that photobombed slide 7. :llama: :camera_with_flash:
rory: Llama limbo was the highlight. clip? need to show my grandma.
geeta: Uploading clip now — trimming only the part where i try to limbo and fail. one sec.
ops-bot: Upload complete: https://redwood.company/all-hands/2525554321/beanie-runway-llama-limbo.mp4
hype-bot: :tada: Official afterparty in #random in 5 minutes. theme: "beanies & chaos". Drop GIFs and one-liners. :tada:
marc: :clap: to design for the impromptu mascot tailoring. the tiny felt beanie looked like it belonged in a museum.
evelyn: snack poll: react with :muffin: for blueberry muffins, :pretzel: for soft pretzels, :no_entry_sign: for nothing. low-stakes governance.
chao: :pretzel: (i will trade my desk plant for a pretzel)
rory: :muffin: muffin diplomacy incoming.
geeta: also logistics: can we get more low tables in the demo room? the runway needs runway-height props.
ops-bot: Note created: "order 4 low demo-room tables, restock beanie box". ticket OPS-521 opened.
hype-bot: mini-contest: best beanie caption wins a sticker pack. post your caption now.
evelyn: "latency went down, beanies went up"
chao: "we shipped hats, not bugs"
rory: "llama approved my PR" (too niche?)
geeta: too niche but delightful. saving for culture-notes.
marc: replay poll: type "replay" if you want the recording link here, or "skip" if not.
evelyn: replay
chao: replay +1
rory: skip (watched live)
ops-bot: Logged: "add beanie captions to culture-notes", "schedule delivery for demo tables". Thanks for the energy folks! :sparkles:
geeta: also, can we make a tiny enamel pin of the llama limbo silhouette? i'd buy one.
hype-bot: Sticker drop scheduled in #swag tomorrow. :pin:
evelyn: love this chaos. see y'all in #random for the beanie afterparty and the llama appreciation hour. keep the GIFs coming :heart:
